visibleEditorialCopy.description: During the Cold War, the organization Patriot assembled a superhero squad from across Soviet republics. Forced underground for years, the hidden team is called back into the open when grave new threats emerge.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, lighthearted, and exciting, making for an effortless, popcorn-ready squad adventure.
